A.notes: Clear, but too dark; needs more brightness and cuteness.

B.notes: Much better, brighter and cuter; requested a younger perceived age.

B2.notes: Perceived age remained effectively unchanged. Keep the current result and defer dedicated voice-candidate work.

C.notes: Previously verified as clear, natural and non-disruptive, but too soft for the default announcement role.

decision.persistent_voice_integration_blocker: The current linux-live command couples voice observation with a renderer; adding it to the existing native-face supervisor would create a second renderer. Extract a voice-only observer first.

next_gate: Provide structured verification outcome IDs before enabling verified-state speech or persistent default integration.
